visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with brown hair and bangs, wearing a red sleeveless top and denim skirt, stands on a city street at night. She has two large silver rings around her torso and is gesturing while talking to someone off-camera. (2) The scene shifts to the front of a Japanese-style restaurant with wooden paneling and lanterns. She poses dynamically with the silver rings, raising one above her head. (3) Inside the restaurant, the woman sits at a table laden with various Japanese dishes, including skewers, sashimi, and fried food. She looks toward the camera with an excited expression and open hands. (4) A series of close-up shots show different dishes: fried shrimp tempura, grilled ox tongue with green onions, and mentaiko chicken skewers, held by the woman. (5) She is seen eating skewers and drinking colorful cocktails (green and orange) from glass mugs. Pink heart graphics and sparkles are overlaid on the screen as she reacts happily. (6) She performs a playful magic trick where a piece of mentaiko vanishes from a skewer and appears on her cheek. (7) She takes a very large bite of green vegetables and later bites into a piece of fried shrimp. (8) She points to a Line QR code sign and then presents a plate of grilled mochi. (9) A man's hand reaches out to tap her on the shoulder while she is sitting on the floor inside the restaurant, still holding the silver rings. They share a humorous exchange and she laughs. (10) The video ends with a black screen displaying the restaurant's name, address, phone number, and Line ID in white text.
